ns2:section.sectionText: Hip Hop: A Global History What are the social, economic, and political forces that have shaped the global Hip Hop cultural movement? How has Hip Hop both been influenced by and helped influence formations of race, gender, class, and sexuality across the world over the past several decades? This course explores the history and development of Hip Hop in the broader context of the post-World War II era by examining the relationship between the cultural movement and such phenomena as the Second Great Migration, deindustrialization, the rise and demise of the Black Power and Black Arts Movements, globalization, and mass incarceration.
